rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site data from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (IBCDR).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort drawn from IBCDR multi-hospital dataset; no listed EPDs reported.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR)."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; healthy-base group used to establish normative model.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Another 289 healthy control individuals (165 female, as a healthy-base group) of 832 controls were included to establish a normative model."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; male_n derived from total N minus reported female_n.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "Another 289 healthy control individuals (165 female, as a healthy-base group) of 832 controls were included to establish a normative model."

rci7_age.detail: Training phase (healthy-base) age statistics not reported.
